"use strict";
function divides(d, n) {
  return n % d === 0;
}
function isPlain(n) {
  return !(divides(3, n) ? true : divides(5, n));
}
function fizzbuzz(n) {
  let var$ = "";
  if (divides(3, n) ? divides(5, n) : false) {
    var$ = "FizzBuzz";
  } else if (divides(3, n)) {
    var$ = "Fizz";
  } else if (divides(5, n)) {
    var$ = "Buzz";
  }
  return var$;
}
let i = 1;
while (i <= 30) {
  if (isPlain(i)) {
    console.log(i);
  } else {
    console.log(fizzbuzz(i));
  }
  i = i + 1;
}
//# sourceMappingURL=fizzbuzz.js.map
